role: Exploratory matched-comparator fallback after both previous outer reports were inspected; not independent confirmation
decision_data: Frozen inner-validation metrics only; no candidate search or outer outcomes enter model choice
decision: Retain the previously selected Jev checkpoint only if its six-positive mean strictly exceeds the selected same-recipe no-Jev checkpoint and every goal is at least -0.005 versus both matched comparator and original anchor; otherwise use the exact matched no-Jev checkpoint
freeze: Freeze all18 pair decisions across both recipes before computing either policy's outer metrics
limitations: This is a new deployment/selection policy, not a correction that changes earlier registered results.
All previous outer data and results were already explored; these estimates are exploratory and need independent confirmation.
Reported benefits are conditional offline ranking estimates, not online causal uplift or universal training uncertainty.
A fallback has exactly zero Jev increment for that model slot; no zero is counted as a strict positive gain.
